trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the biggest single requirement in the game: PowerPyx, GTABase and Push Square agree on the checklist, which covers story missions, optional missions, vehicles, animals, meditations, challenges, stunts, WAiNK scans, card sets, robberies, shooting-range golds, drone races and more. Work on it across the whole playthrough rather than leaving it all for the end, and use the roadmap in this app to track the pieces.
steps: Complete the story and 100 optional missions.
Discover 200 of 277 base vehicle models.
Study 100 of 255 animals with binoculars.
Meditate at 15 of 18 spots, complete 70 of 80 challenges and 300 stunts, and scan 100 WAiNK locations.
Complete 15 of 18 card sets, all robberies, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks.
tips: PowerPyx and GTABase estimate the platinum run at around 200 hours; Push Square says 300 hours or more, so treat any single number as an estimate.
The 100% checklist is the same list that feeds the other grind trophies, so progress overlaps heavily.

Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one.
tips: There are 8 Large Bank Jobs in total, so you can choose the five you find easiest.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. First get the Key Cloner: it is given automatically at the start of the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy. Then go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City, clone the key of the blue Bravado Banshee, and drive it straight out through the showroom window. Keep driving down the street — the trophy pops a moment after you drive away. Only that blue Banshee counts.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs until you receive the Key Cloner (it is given automatically at the start of the mission).
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City.
Use the Key Cloner on the blue Bravado Banshee.
Drive the Banshee straight through the showroom window and keep going down the street until the trophy pops.
tips: Only the blue Banshee counts — no other car in the showroom will do.
The trophy pops a moment after you drive off, not the instant you break the window, so keep driving.
Neither guide names the showroom, so look for the showroom in the south of Vice City rather than a named dealership.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Finish Chapter 1 first, then go alone — without your partner — to the road northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, east of Port Gellhorn, at night after 2:00 AM in-game time. Look for a parked car with flickering headlights at the roadside; its spawn is slightly random, so if it is not there, leave and come back later. Follow the trail from the car into the woods toward the blue UFO light. The UFO drops off a woman it abducted — talk to her, offer to help, and walk back to her car. The UFO comes back and abducts your character instead, and the trophy unlocks. Your character wakes up three days later.
steps: Complete Chapter 1.
At night after 2:00 AM in-game time, go alone to the road northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, east of Port Gellhorn.
Look for a parked car with flickering or flashing headlights at the roadside. If it is not there, leave and return later — the spawn is slightly random.
Follow the trail from the car into the woods toward the blue UFO light.
Talk to the abducted woman the UFO drops off and offer to help, then walk back to her car — the UFO returns and abducts your character.
tips: Come alone — the event is for a solo character, without your partner.
Either Jason or Lucia can do this.
The follow-up content — the Area 51 base, the keypad code and the dream puzzle — is separate and is not needed for this trophy.
